Download the PEExcel verification tool and key application and verification documents.

## Excel tool

| Version | Use | Download |
|---|---|---|
| [**v1.12.7 — Stable**](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/releases/tag/v1.12.7) | Regular use and testing | [Excel verification tool](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/raw/refs/heads/master/excel/tool/ka_PEQ_Nachweistool.xlsb) |
| **v1.13.x — Development** | Development, testing new features and ongoing adjustments | [Development workbook](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/raw/refs/heads/master/excel/development/ka_PEQ_Nachweistool_DEV.xlsb) |

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Which version should I use?"}
Use the released tool version for regular project assessments and declarations. The development version may include new or not fully checked features.

Consult [release notes](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/releases) and the [changelog](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md). Document the version used for verification.
:::

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Caution"}
The Excel application requires **Microsoft Excel with VBA macro support, at least version 365**. MS Office 2019 is not supported.
:::

::: {.excel-operation}
**Preparing the workbook**

1. Download and save the Excel file locally.
2. Open it in Microsoft Excel.
3. If Windows blocks the file, use **Properties → Unblock** provided it comes from a trusted source.
4. Enable macros for the intended interface functions.
5. Keep an unchanged copy as a starting file.

Continue with [getting started](excel-overview.qmd).
:::
